title: A minimal scalar score
teaches: A track is one target plus keyframes. Values interpolate linearly by default, and the first and last key hold outside their span, so a score needs no explicit boundary keys.
observe: t = 0 is the first key exactly; t = 1 s is the 2 b midpoint.
t = 3 s is past the last key: the write stays 0.8.
t = -0.5 s is before the first key: the write stays 0.2.
